column70: Once per round when a  Spindleweb Fanatic is killed, Kar'niss can use a Legendary Action to possibly deal 6d10⁠⁠Psychic and  Silence the attacker.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead is a passive feature available to Apostle of Myrkul in Honour Mode that allows him to use a Legendary action to retaliate against an attacker.
column70: Once per round, Myrkul's Apostle can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Gaze of the Dead on a creature when attacked.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Gossamer Tomb is a passive feature available to the Phase Spider Matriarch in Honour mode, that lets her entomb in web a creature attacking one of her spiderlings.
column70: Once per round if her offspring is attacked, the Phase Spider Matriarch can spend a Legendary Action to use  Gossamer Tomb.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Grasping Appendage is a legendary action passive feature available to Malus Thorm, that lets him pull an enemy towards him.
column70: Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action to  Grasp a creature and pull it closer.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Heartwrench is a passive feature available to Viconia DeVir on Honour Mode.
column70: Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to  Heartwrench a  Heartform Mapped creature after it strikes her or her allies.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Hordestrike is a passive feature available to Ketheric in Honour mode.
column70: Once per round, Ketheric can spend a Legendary Action to  Hordestrike an enemy when it is attacked by one of his minions following  Deadly Orders.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Leaping Static is a passive feature available to Bernard in Honour mode. It lets Bernard use the legendary action Leaping Static as a reaction to being attacked.
column70: Once per round, Bernard can spend a Legendary Action to immediately launch  Leaping Static at a foe after being attacked.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Mind-Claw of Tu'narath is a passive feature affecting Ch'r'ai W'wargaz on Honour mode. It allows him to use a Legendary action to summons a deadly psionic blade in response to the inquisitor or an ally being attacked.
column70: Twice per round, Inquisitor W'wargaz can spend a Legendary Action to summon a Mind-Claw of Tu'narath after he or his allies are struck.  When the claw strikes, W'wargaz may  Mindsteal Link with a target not already affected by this condition. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew is a passive feature used by Thisobald Thorm in Honour Mode, which lets him use his legendary action  Overflowing Brew.
column70: Once per round, Thisobald Thorm can use his Legendary Action when his brew is changed by a foe's attack to make it overflow, dealing 3d6 of the corresponding damage type.  The overflow also grants his allies +5 bonus to Strength or an additional +1d6 damage of the corresponding damage type. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage is a legendary passive feature available to Nere in Honour mode. When attacked, Nere can cast Psionic Visage to protect himself from ⁠Physical damage with 3 psionic copies of himself.
column70: Once per round, Nere can use his Legendary Action to cast  Psionic Visage on himself when attacked.  When he is attacked, Nere's summoned visages will  Detonate. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Ptarian Dogma is a passive feature available to Ptaris in Honour mode which lets him pacify a foe that strikes him.
column70: Once per round, after being hit, Ptaris can spend a Legendary Action to surround his attacker in  Ptarian Pacifism.

column69: Legendary Action: Sanctuary of Loss is a passive feature available to Viconia DeVir on Honour Mode.
column70: Once per round, Viconia can use a Legendary Action to cast  Sanctuary of Loss when an ally is struck.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash is a passive feature available to Orin, that lets her use Sanguine Lash after being attacked, or places Bhaal's Edict on a creature if she does not. Although the in-game text does not mention it, Orin will only activate this attack against foes who hit her with melee attacks.
column70: Once per round, Orin can use her Legendary Action to  Sanguine Lash after being attacked.  If Orin does not use her Legendary Action in a round and is not dueling her opponent alone,  Bhaal's Edict is placed on a creature. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Shredding Scales is a passive feature available to the Bulette in Honour Mode.
column70: Once per turn, the Bulette can spend a Legendary Action to use  Shredding Scales after being hit if its  Diamond Scales are active.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Soul Ascension is a passive feature available to Raphael while he is in his  Fiendish Ascension form. It lets him expend a legendary action to use Soul Ascension, after he or his allies are attacked.
column70: Raphael can spend a Legendary Action to immediately cast  Soul Ascension when he or his allies are attacked.  Raphael may use this Legendary Action as many times per round as there are Soul Pillars standing at the start of the round. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Soul Sacrifice is a passive feature available to Ch'r'ai Tska'an in Honour mode, which lets her use the legendary action  Sacrifice Soul immediately after a humanoid has died.
column70: Once per round when a humanoid dies, the Ch'r'ai can spend a legendary action to  Sacrifice its soul to ⁠Vlaakith in return for great power. Once 3 souls have been sacrificed, the Ch'r'ai takes on  Vlaakith's Undying Aspect.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Spectral Aspect is a passive feature that can grant a special spectral form after being struck.
column70: Once per round, Balthazar can use his Legendary Action to adopt a  Spectral Aspect after being struck.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Sublimation is a passive feature used by Gerringothe Thorm on Honour Mode. After losing a piece of armour, Gerringothe can use a Legendary action to try to  Sublimate a foe. A creature that fails its save against this effect cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions.
column70: Once per round, if she loses a piece of armour, Gerringothe Thorm can spend a Legendary Action to try and turn her enemies into gold, incapacitating them for 4 turns.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Torrential Undeath is a passive feature available to Mystic Carrion in Honour Mode.
column70: Once per turn, Mystic Carrion can use his Legendary Action to release  Torrential Undeath at his foes when hit.  This grants Undead  Guardian Wraiths while haunting other creatures with  Wrathful Spirits. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Tu'narath's Embrace is a passive feature used by Har'rak in Honour mode that lets him use  Tu'narath's Embrace on nearby allies when they are attacked with an incapacitating condition.
column70: Once per round, Ch'r'ai Har'rak can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Tu'narath's Embrace on an ally to prevent an Incapacitating Condition.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.   Details    Recharge: Per turn

column69: Legendary Action: Tyrannical Branding is a passive feature available to Enver Gortash in Honour Mode that lets him use a Legendary action to retaliate against his attacker.
column70: Once per round, Gortash can use his Legendary Action to immediately  Brand his attacker after being struck.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm is a passive feature available to Cazador on Honour Mode.
column70: Once per round, Cazador can spend a Legendary Action to conjure a  Vampiric Swarm.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Vengeful Playmate is a passive feature available to Oliver in Honour Mode.
column70: Once per round, Oliver can spend a Legendary Action to summon  The Wasting Quiet in an area after a summoned shadow is slain.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Wail of Loss is a passive feature available to Malus Thorm in Honour Mode.
column70: Once per round, Malus Thorm can use his Legendary Action after being attacked to make every assistant cast  Wail of Loss simultaneously.  Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.

column69: Legendary Action: Weird Magic Surge is a passive feature available to Ethel in Honour mode, which lets her use the legendary action  Weird Magic Surge immediately after a spell is cast. A higher level spell will produce more illusory duplicates.
column70: Once per round, Auntie Ethel can spend a Legendary Action to summon more illusory duplicates and shuffle herself among them after a spell is cast.  A higher level spell will result in more illusory duplicates being summoned. Legendary Actions restore at the start of each round.
